brief:
The Trump administration's solicitor general has asked the Supreme Court to reverse a lower court's decision releasing a Georgetown scholar, according to Al Jazeera English. The case has ignited constitutional debate over detention authority and judicial oversight. The original ruling had ordered the scholar's release from government custody.

Details of the administration's specific arguments and the scholar's identity were not immediately available. The solicitor general's challenge seeks to overturn the lower court's finding, suggesting a dispute over the legal grounds for the scholar's detention.
dek: US solicitor general challenges lower court's ruling on Georgetown scholar's detention, sparking constitutional debates.
title: Trump administration challenges Palestinian scholar's court-ordered release
